notes: Aggregates current Form SSA-1099 box-6 voluntary federal-withholding findings into the family subtotal, one of the five document subtotals Form 1040 line 25b adds (i1040gi-2025 l.2559-2576: social security benefits withholding shown in box 6 of Form SSA-1099). Closed-empty publishes zero only through current literal-true closure. A statement with no box-6 amount recorded is not a member and adds nothing. Published as its own rule so the explanation walk reaches this document. Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 4): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents; the line that adds it rounds the total once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its guards are unchanged.
